crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:41.title: Shipping Technician
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:41.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations has been an industry leader in the design and supply of high-voltage, open-air substations, and switchyards since 1965. Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations is looking to hire a Shipping Technician to work from our Port of Alexandria Facility in our Warehouse Department. The Shipping Technician is responsible for performing duties related to the shipping, receiving, marshaling, and warehousing of stock inventory and project specific jobs-in-process inventory. The Shipping Technician is a member of the Project Support Services Department and reports directly to the Logistics Manager. The Shipping Technician is expected to conduct all work with the highest quality and professionalism and with the understanding that this position represents the last in the Company’s process to touch the product / service before the customer receives it.
responsibilities: Performs tasks related to Project Services operations, included but not limited to: unloading of inbound trucks, receiving & inspecting materials, packaging / banding / bundling / wrapping of shipments, reeling / spooling cable, constructing wooden shipping crates, performing light manufacturing (drilling / cutting of aluminum and/or copper conductors), consolidating shipments by project and loading outbound trucks.
Attends safety meetings as requested / instructed.
Operates all machinery and equipment, including the Company’s forklift, in a safe manner always.

Communicates frequently with the Logistics and the Project Coordinators or Project Managers concerning material receiving / shipping issues, material damage and coordination of all inbound/outbound logistics.

Assist all Project Coordinators and Project Managers with the delivery of emergency products, recognize and share lessons learned (both good and bad) to all project coordinators and the company management and recognize and promote opportunities for quality and productivity improvements.

Keeps the Project Service Center property in order, including but not limited to: routine maintenance and grooming of grounds and facilities and regular and preventative maintenance on all Company equipment and machinery.
Promotes company goals.
Works to displays an excellent safety record

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:a98.title: Corporate Recruiter
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:a98.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omni-channel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis—our operating platform unifying a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services—to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and more—premier home and outdoor banners that double as real-world innovation hubs. CSC Generation continues to grow through M&A, revitalizing companies with strong brand recognition and loyal customers. Reports to: Head of Talent Acquisition Location: Toronto (Hybrid); Salt Lake City (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office); Austin (Hybrid); All other Canada & US (Remote)
responsibilities: Partner with hiring managers across portfolio brands to understand role requirements, advise on best practices, and define recruitment strategies for each open position
Own full-cycle recruiting: source, review, screen, and evaluate qualified applicants for engineering, finance, creative, and other professional roles
Conduct phone screens, in-person interviews, and candidate assessments to evaluate technical ability, culture alignment, and long-term fit
Build and maintain candidate pipelines for future hiring needs, converting prospects into active candidates and eventual hires
Use data-driven approaches to recruiting—track and report on key metrics throughout the recruitment lifecycle and translate insights into process improvements
Lead efforts to establish and grow CSC Generation's recruiting presence in Canada, identifying top talent markets and sourcing channels
Manage multiple requisitions simultaneously, prioritizing effectively and keeping all stakeholders informed on progress
qualifications: Minimum 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within e-commerce, fintech, or technology companies
Demonstrated ability to source and evaluate engineering, finance, and creative talent across North America
Strong understanding of the candidate marketplace in both the US and Canada
Experience using data and reporting to drive recruiting decisions and improve outcomes
Ability to manage multiple open requisitions and competing priorities without dropping quality
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—comfortable advising hiring managers on process and strategy
High ownership mentality with a track record of delivering results with minimal oversight

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0340d2c4-d735-.title: Head of Data Center Design
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0340d2c4-d735-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Center Design based in Switzerland. As Head of Data Center Design, you will take ownership of the technical vision and architecture for a major next-generation AI data center development in Europe. You’ll lead design decisions across power, cooling, IT infrastructure, fire protection, networking, and structural considerations. The role offers significant technical influence, from early site feasibility and concept development through detailed engineering and construction execution. You’ll establish the Basis of Design and ensure that multidisciplinary teams remain aligned with performance, capacity, efficiency, and reliability objectives. Working with technology partners and implementation teams, you’ll ensure approved designs translate effectively into real-world infrastructure. The environment is international, technically complex, and focused on large-scale, high-density compute infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape a critical infrastructure project designed to support the rapidly growing demands of AI and advanced computing. Own the overall technical design, architecture, and engineering vision for large-scale data center facilities. Define and maintain the Basis of Design , covering modular POD architecture, cooling strategy, power topology, fire suppression, networking, and other critical infrastructure requirements. Establish design standards for IT deployment, including rack layouts, containerization approaches, and CDU placement. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews and approve engineering drawings across electrical, mechanical, structural, fire protection, and networking disciplines. Establish and monitor design-stage targets for PUE, capacity, availability, redundancy, and reliability . Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and engineering partners on technical specifications and integration requirements. Work closely with implementation and construction teams to ensure that physical execution remains aligned with the approved design intent. Assess and approve proposed design changes, evaluating their potential impact on cooling, power, capacity, redundancy, performance, and reliability. Lead technical criteria for site selection and feasibility assessments, including power availability, grid connectivity, cooling options, and other infrastructure considerations. Provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle and ensure consistent engineering standards across projects and disciplines. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data center design or in the design of critical infrastructure, industrial, energy, or similarly complex facilities ; direct data center experience is highly valued but not mandatory. Demonstrated ownership of, or significant contribution to, Basis of Design documentation for large-scale facilities. At least 3 years of experience in a design leadership or technical leadership position. Strong technical knowledge of power distribution/topology and cooling strategies , with sufficient working knowledge of fire suppression and structural loading to coordinate effectively across disciplines. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and reviewing or approving engineering drawings across multiple technical trades. Strong ability to translate technical requirements into clear design standards, decisions, and execution requirements. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams, technology partners, suppliers, and construction teams. Professional English proficiency sufficient for international technical documentation, meetings, and stakeholder communication. Experience with modular or POD-based deployment architectures and high-density GPU/HPC environments is a strong advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems is

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c7967640-7ab5-.title: Social Media Manager for X
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c7967640-7ab5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Manager for X based in Portugal. This is an opportunity to become the voice of a fast-growing crypto platform on X and play a central role in shaping its presence within Crypto Twitter. You will monitor conversations, trends, memes, and breaking news to identify opportunities for timely and engaging content. The role combines community management, social copywriting, content creation, and hands-on engagement with users and industry voices. You will work closely with marketing and product teams to bring campaigns to life while maintaining a distinctive and authentic brand voice. The ideal candidate is deeply immersed in crypto culture, understands how online communities communicate, and knows what makes content resonate. You will have significant creative ownership and the opportunity to help define how a widely used crypto product participates in the conversation. This role is suited to a social-native professional who thrives in a fast-moving environment and can move quickly when the feed demands it. Monitor X trends, conversations, breaking news, memes, competitors, and influential accounts to identify opportunities for timely and relevant content. Build and maintain an active presence within the Crypto Twitter community through thoughtful, entertaining, and strategic replies. Develop relationships with influencers, creators, brands, users, and other relevant members of the crypto ecosystem. Create engaging social content that reflects the brand voice, communicates product value, and resonates with the target community. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to translate product launches, campaigns, and initiatives into compelling content for X. Develop social copy, memes, and other creative formats designed to increase engagement, awareness, and community participation. Stay highly responsive to rapidly developing conversations and news, adapting working hours when necessary to capitalize on important moments. Contribute ideas and expertise across broader marketing initiatives where additional strengths in content, social, or creative marketing can add value. Help continuously refine the brand's voice, tone, and social media strategy based on community feedback, performance, and emerging trends. Requirements Deep understanding of social media platforms, trends, formats, and community-building principles. Strong knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Crypto Twitter culture, with genuine familiarity with the community and its language. Demonstrated experience building, managing, or actively engaging a social media following on X. Strong social copywriting skills and the ability to create concise, entertaining, culturally relevant content. Experience creating memes and understanding the formats, humor, references, and conventions that perform well within online crypto communities. Strong awareness of current crypto narratives, influential personalities, projects, communities, and industry developments. Ability to identify opportunities quickly and respond to fast-moving conversations without compromising quality or brand alignment. Strong communication, creativity, judgment, and community engagement skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and adapt priorities in a rapidly changing environment. Basic graphic design and video editing skills are a plus. Experience creating content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit, or other social platforms is a plus. Additional marketing capabilities, such as content writing or broader content strategy, are also welcome. Benefits Opportunity to take ownership of the X presence and voice of a growing crypto platform. Exposure to a fast-moving international crypto environment and a large, engaged user community. titanwh-titanwh:lever:7c4ea028-f47e-47e9.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Regulatory
titanwh-titanwh:lever:7c4ea028-f47e-47e9.description: Titan Wealth is a fast-growing wealth management business, both in the UK and internationally. It has evolved a fairer, more efficient and effective business model, structured to deliver leading advice-led wealth management services, giving financial advisers and their clients the best opportunity to fulfil their dreams and ambitions. We provide a dynamic work environment full of opportunity, one where both individual and team initiative and contribution is encouraged, so that together we can deliver better outcomes for our clients over the long term. The Titan Wealth Legal team are looking to recruit an enthusiastic, proactive and resilient candidate who thrives on the pressures of delivering consistently high-quality advice to a dynamic and constantly evolving business, for a challenging and rewarding Wealth Management legal role focusing on regulatory advisory (UK and international) work to join their legal team on a permanent basis. The role requires the ability to manage a diverse workload of matters ranging from keeping abreast of regulatory developments impacting the Titan Wealth businesses, advising on regulatory implementations to assessing regulatory implications of new business initiatives and specific client situations.
responsibilities: Advise on and interpret regulations issued by financial regulatory bodies, including the FCA and other relevant regulators, in conjunction with Titan Wealth compliance colleagues and external legal counsel where required (typically ex-UK)
Act as the primary legal point of contact for all regulatory legal queries and enquiries
Act as the primary legal point of contact for developments and implementation of regulatory compliance programmes and projects
Draft, review and negotiate agreements, contracts and other legal documents in line with current regulatory requirements, utilising external legal counsel when required
Ensure the timely and effective communication of legal risks associated with regulatory developments to the relevant business areas

Oversee the appointment and management of external legal counsel on regulatory legal matters ensuring that the advice and support provided is in line with budgetary requirements whilst ensuring that the advice and support provided is commercial, risk based and of high quality
Oversee / monitor more junior members of the team (as appropriate) and be willing to take online management responsibilities
Assist with enabling product launches, supporting new permissions, managing regulatory risk in integration and improving processes/template
Working closely with the legal, compliance and vendor team.
qualifications: Legal qualification: 6 + yrs PQE with broad regulatory legal experience working within a regulated financial services organization and/or law firm
In-house experience is desirable but not compulsory
A well rounded, broadly based and highly regarded regulatory legal specialist with first rate academic credentials, demonstrable intellectual abilities and an excellent career track record to date
An in-depth understanding of the financial services industry and demonstrable wide-ranging regulatory legal expertise
A business oriented lawyer with the breadth of experience covering a broad range of legal and regulatory issues across the entire Group, individual business areas and central functions
Ability to think strategically and creatively see legal issues in their wider context and advise accordingly
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, strong organisational skills and judgement, excellent analysis, drafting and negotiation skills
Self-motivated to drive delivery against objectives and an ability to work autonomously and manage own caseload effectively

Willingness to learn and build good working relationships with internal stakeholders, identifying areas of improvement in relation to contractual documentation, policies, procedures and standards, working closely with Compliance colleagues
Accustomed to operating in a high-paced environment and with a successful track record of aligning legal priorities and business goals
An ability to provide commercial, risk based and incisive legal advice, guidance and support with sound legal judgement
Experience in vendor / platform onboarding (SaaS, custody, data providers), outsourcing and operational resilience, data protection / cross ‑ border structuring.
